Show all your working.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest an advantage of calculating the number of new cases per 100 000 each year in the prevention and control of TB across the world.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
TB is endemic (always present) in many populations across the world and many countries have high numbers of cases.

State **two** reasons why it is difficult to reduce the number of cases of TB across the world.
